latestVersion.changelog:
ClawDefender v1.0.1

- Tuned pattern detection to reduce false positives.

raw_record.summary: Security scanner and input sanitizer for AI agents. Detects prompt injection, command injection, SSRF, credential exfiltration, and path traversal attacks. Use when (1) installing new skills from ClawHub, (2) processing external input like emails, calendar events, Trello cards, or API responses, (3) validating URLs before fetching, (4) running security audits on your workspace. Protects agents from malicious content in untrusted data sources.
